label: late input-phase / <DEL> steps, gated by first token (w,d,0,e,c,u) and current input (p,r,y,1,2,<DEL>)
explanation: Active almost only in the input phase from t>=3 and at the <DEL> step (74% / 26% of mass; copy phase ~0.3%); never at t<3. Rate rises with position and with L. Within that window it is a combinatorial code: much more likely when the first original token is w, d, 0, e, c or u (w 5.7x, d 4.6x) and when the current input is p, r, y, 1, 2 or <DEL>; fires mostly on first occurrences of the input token. The best conjunction (late input/DEL & first-token set & input-token set) reaches only dev F1 0.29, precision 0.21, mass recall 0.55; top activations (~0.2) are sequences starting with w/d and inputs r/y/p/<DEL>. Does not fire in the copy phase or on repeated tokens. Looks like a distributed hidden-state readout with no compact predicate.
